items.control_name: Enforce Trusted Launch (Secure Boot & vTPM) on Azure VMs
items.description: Azure VMs must be deployed with Trusted Launch security type enabled (SecureBoot and vTPM = True).
items.current_value: 14 VMs use Trusted Launch; 2 legacy VMs use Standard Gen1 type
items.remediation_notes: Plan migration of Gen1 legacy VMs 'vm-sql-legacy' and 'vm-ad-legacy' to Gen2 Trusted Launch.

items.control_name: Enforce Azure Bastion for Secure Remote VM Administration
items.description: Remote RDP/SSH access to VMs must traverse an Azure Bastion host without public IP assignment on VMs.
items.current_value: Azure Bastion deployed in 'vnet-hub-prod'; 0 VMs have Public IPs assigned
items.recommended_value: 100% Bastion-managed administrative access; 0 VM Public IPs
items.evidence_source: az network public-ip list / az network bastion list
items.remediation_notes: Require Entra ID native authentication for Bastion sessions.

items.control_name: Enforce AKS Private Cluster with Azure AD / Entra ID RBAC
items.description: AKS clusters must be private (enablePrivateCluster = True) and use Microsoft Entra ID integration for RBAC.
items.current_value: Cluster 'aks-prod-01' is Private with Entra RBAC and Azure Policy Add-on enabled
items.remediation_notes: Disable local account admin access using 'az aks update --disable-local-accounts'.

items.control_name: Enforce Azure Policy Add-on for AKS Pod Security Standards
items.description: AKS clusters must run the Azure Policy add-on to enforce Baseline/Restricted Pod Security Standards.
items.current_value: Azure Policy Add-on enabled on 100% of AKS clusters
items.recommended_value: Azure Policy Add-on active with Pod Security Restricted initiative
items.remediation_notes: Audit policy violations in Policy Compliance dashboard.
